findings.comment: The check `\is_object($value) && is_subclass_of($value::class, \UnitEnum::class)` can be replaced with `$value instanceof \UnitEnum`. `instanceof` safely handles non-objects and avoids the overhead of inspecting the class string via `is_subclass_of`. Calling `self::enum(...)` is also more consistent with surrounding branches like `self::object()`.
